description_en: Deletes personnel information from a cost center
description_zh: 删除成本中心人员信息
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen entity-delete --thirdpart-id 12345 --del-all true --entity-d-o-list entity_type=1 entity_id=123 --x-acs-btrip-so-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EntityDelete

parameters.help_en: The ID of the third-party cost center
parameters.name: thirdpart_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to delete all members
parameters.name: del_all

element_fields.help_en:
The type of the available scope. Valid values:

1: user
2: department
3: role
element_fields.name: entity_type

element_fields.help_en: The ID of the user, department, or role
element_fields.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en: The list of members to delete. This parameter is not required when delAll is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 删除的成员信息列表,delAll为true时可不填
parameters.name: entity_d_o_list

parameters.help_en: The header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise access credential" operation (added in the header). In HTTP mode, you can use so_corp_token=value or dtb_corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数 由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用so_corp_token=value或者dtb_corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token
